notes: Measures the GSP VRAM decode by writing markers into live MAME at frame 600, rather than by reading multisync_gsp_map. Share is 4194304 bytes, first non-distinct offset 0x400000; mapped iff (addr & 0x7f800000) == 0x7f800000; offset = addr & 0x3fffff. Both native/ VRAM paths mask with 0x7ffff via a 0x80000 constant and therefore disagree with this for 745,384 of the 843,688 captured 0xFFxxxxxx writes. Confirms docs/mc68010-boot-findings.md section 19. Reproducible: two runs differed only in the GSP PC field.
